    • IDF shelled Hezbollah sites after a soldier was wounded in a clash in southern Lebanon. Exchanges continue daily.

  • US–Israel military coordination
    • Netanyahu and Trump spoke; agreed to meet soon in the US.
    • IDF Chief Zamir met top US commander to tighten Lebanon/Hezbollah cooperation and strategy.
  • Russia – Iran ties & logistics
    • Medvedev met Iranian leadership. Russian Railways offered to develop grain transport to Iran — logistical lifeline and political signal.
  • Energy & sanctions
    • Iran in talks with Japanese firms on oil sales under a temporary US sanctions waiver — limited market openings appearing.
  • Regional spillover
    • Houthis claim missile strikes on Saudi aircraft over Yemen — more potential frontlines and wider instability risk.
  • Humanitarian/operational
    • Commercial flight shutdown and heavy casualties in Lebanon strain evacuation and aid routes.
  • 🟢 Good News
    • Second pause and ongoing mediation open a window to reduce immediate energy-target strikes. Russia offers grain transport; limited oil sales talks under waiver may ease supply stress.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

48.en:
Situation Report — Day 27 (last 48h)

  • Active: Israeli/US airstrikes on Iran continue. Iran, Hezbollah and Gaza-linked groups launch missile/rocket strikes at Israel. Northern border sees daily Hezbollah fire.
  • Airspace / Civilian impact: Major regional airspace disruption. Airports in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon and Jordan reported closed. Civil flights grounded repeatedly.
  • Northern Border (Lebanon): IDF shelled multiple Hezbollah sites after clash injured an Israeli soldier. Israeli reports: strikes on ~10 Hezbollah facilities. Lebanese health ministry reports >4,300 killed in Lebanon since March 2.
  • Iran strikes & pauses: President Trump announced a SECOND 10-day pause on US strikes targeting Iranian energy infrastructure (deadline Apr 6, 2026 20:00 ET), citing an “Iranian Government request” and saying talks are “going very well.” Iran denies direct talks. First pause (Mar 23, 5 days) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr — lowers trust in pauses.
  • Diplomacy & mediation: Pakistan reported mediating between parties. US-Iran contacts continue per multiple reports. NYT/others allege an Israeli plot to target Iranian negotiators — risks derailing talks.
  • International moves: Russia engaged at leadership level (Medvedev met Iranian leaders; attended Khamenei mourning). Iran opened Strait of Hormuz passage selectively (Russia, India, China permitted; others denied). Japan in talks to buy Iranian oil under a temporary US waiver. Russian rail interest in grain-to-Iran noted.
  • Regional spillover: Houthis claim missile strikes on Saudi aircraft and threaten Saudi airspace. Risk of wider Gulf involvement persists.
  • 🟢 Good News: Temporary 10-day pause announced and Pakistan mediation offer a diplomatic window.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.

  • מרחב אווירי / אזרחי: הפרעות נרחבות. נמלי תעופה באיראן, ישראל, עיראק, סוריה, לבנון וירדן דיווחו על סגירות.
  • גבול הצפוני (לבנון): צה"ל ירה לעבר אתרי חיזבאללה לאחר תקיפה שהשיתה חייל. דוברות צה"ל: תקיפות על כ־10 מתקני חיזבאללה. משרד הבריאות הלבנוני מדווח על מעל 4,300 הרוגים מאז 2 במרץ.
